capture.note: ResourceDescs.json/Passes.json are concatenated JSON objects. Strides/sizes/formats under storage.capture come from Base/ResourceDescs.json. The only raw payload inspected was Shadow.Virtual.ProjectionData (one 368-byte record), used to disambiguate the ProjectionData field offsets; no other raw .bin was decoded.

coverage.note: Every name in visibility-required.json matches exactly one resourceSchemas selector; family-level gaps are listed in coverageGaps by appliesTo.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one packed uint32 page-table entry per (virtual shadow map, mip level, virtual page)
resourceSchemas.units: bitfield; physical page address in page units (1 page = 128x128 texels); LODOffset in mip levels
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: virtual-shadow-map page-table texel space: a packed 2D atlas, texel address from CalcPageTableLevelOffset(VSM, mip) + virtual page address (VirtualShadowMapPageAccessCommon.ush:127-147)

formatAlternatives: PF_R32_UINT single-mip page table (captured for the previous-frame copy; the current-frame table uses the same layout)

fields.name: LODOffset
fields.decode: (entry >> 20u) & 0x3Fu; 0 = page mapped at this level, >0 = pointer to coarser mapped page

fields.name: Unused
fields.decode: zero in ShadowEncodePageTable; not read by ShadowDecodePageTable

mathTerms: VSM_PAGE_SIZE=128, VSM_LOG2_PAGE_SIZE=7, VSM_MAX_MIP_LEVELS=8, VSM_LEVEL0_DIM_PAGES_XY=128 (VirtualShadowMapDefinitions.h:13-20)
Physical page address is 10 bits per axis, so the pool is limited to 1024x1024 pages per axis; the row shift/mask are uniform-buffer values (PhysicalPageRowShift/Mask), not stored in the entry
Entry 0 means unmapped/invalid (VSM_PHYSICAL_PAGE_INVALID)
gaps: The page-table atlas extent depends on runtime NumPageTablesEntriesPerRow (VSMARRAY_C:2649-2658); the 8192x192 extent is capture-specific.
No capture bytes were decoded for this family in this step; bit layout is proven by ShadowEncodePageTable/ShadowDecodePageTable only.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 6-bit flag word per virtual page per hierarchical mip level (7 mips in capture)
resourceSchemas.units: bit flags (VSM_FLAG_*)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: same page-table texel space as Shadow.Virtual.PageTable; mip level = hierarchical LOD above the page

formatAlternatives: current frame PageFlags (same layout, not a required family)

transforms.name: hierarchicalOr
transforms.expression: Flag(mipLevel) = OR over 2x2 footprint of Flag(mipLevel-1); each mip texel keeps the 6-bit OR of its children

mathTerms: VSM_PAGE_FLAGS_BITS_PER_HMIP=6, mask 0x3F (PageAccessCommon.ush:29-30)
The 7 mip levels are the hierarchical flag pyramid built by GenerateHierarchicalPageFlags (5..0 of VSM_MAX_MIP_LEVELS); each texel stores flags, not a packed multi-Hmip word
Extended flags (VSM_EXTENDED_FLAG_*, bits 6..15) live in FPhysicalPageMetaData.Flags, not in this texture
gaps: Only the low 6 bits are meaningful; upper bits are not written by the hierarchical pass.
The capture shows 7 mips; NumMips is derived from VSM_LOG2_PAGE_SIZE+1, not from a fixed constant in this file.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint32 request word per page-table texel (single mip; cleared every frame)
resourceSchemas.units: bit flags (VSM_FLAG_* marks) or 0 = not requested
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: same page-table texel space as Shadow.Virtual.PageTable

formatAlternatives: allocated with bAllocateMipLevels=false, so exactly 1 mip

mathTerms: The texel word is nonzero iff the page was requested this frame (PhysicalPageManagement.usf:282-283); for pixel pages marking writes VSM_FLAG_ALLOCATED|VSM_FLAG_DETAIL_GEOMETRY|VSM_FLAG_PRIMARY_REQUEST.
Written non-atomically by marking (MarkPage: OutPageRequestFlags[addr]=Flags).
Cleared at frame start with AddClearPageTableUAVPass(...,0u) (VSMARRAY_C:2737-2738).
gaps: Only the request-bit meanings proven by MarkPage are asserted; prefiltered-distant/secondary-request marking site is not anchored in this step.
The capture byteSize includes mip0 only (8192x192x4 = 6291456).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint4 inclusive page rectangle per (shadow-map data index, mip level); 4 names are the current allocation, current uncached-render set, and their previous-frame copies
resourceSchemas.units: virtual page coordinates (1 page = 128 texels)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: per shadow map, page space of the level: valid range [0, 128>>mipLevel)

transforms.name: rectLayout
transforms.expression: Index = VirtualShadowMap.GetDataIndex()*VSM_MAX_MIP_LEVELS + MipLevel; rect is inclusive (Min<=Max); empty rect = (128,128,0,0)

mathTerms: NumPageRects = GetNumShadowMapSlots() * VSM_MAX_MIP_LEVELS; allocation rounded up to a power of two (VSMARRAY_C:2796-2799).
Cleared to uint4(VSM_LEVEL0_DIM_PAGES_XY, VSM_LEVEL0_DIM_PAGES_XY, 0, 0) = (128,128,0,0) so InterlockedMin/Max are valid (InitPageRectBounds:129-131).
Allocated includes mapped+cached pages; Uncached/PageRectBounds only pages with VSM_FLAG_ANY_UNCACHED (GenerateHierarchicalPageFlags:203-210).
gaps: The capture distinguishes 131072 elements = 16384 slots x 8 mips; per-capture slot count is runtime data, not a schema constant.
PrevAllocatedPageRectBounds/PrevUncachedPageRectBounds are re-registered previous-frame buffers; their producer is the same pass in the prior frame.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 4 int32 lists, each MaxPhysicalPages entries followed by one int32 count; LRU, available, empty, requested
resourceSchemas.units: physical page linear index; trailing element is an element count
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: physical page pool linear index = y<<PhysicalPageRowShift + x (page, not texel)

formatAlternatives: items are int32; INDEX_NONE (-1) marks removed LRU slots

fields.name: ListItem
fields.decode: list[PageList][i] for i in [0,Count); value = physical page index or -1 in LRU holes

fields.name: ListCount
fields.decode: list[PageList][MaxPhysicalPages] = current count; per list base = PageList*(MaxPhysicalPages+1)

transforms.name: listBases
transforms.expression: base(PageList) = PageList*(MaxPhysicalPages+1); indices 0..3 = LRU, AVAILABLE, EMPTY, REQUESTED

mathTerms: PUSH at the tail via atomic count increment; POP from the tail (count-1). Overflow is prevented by refusing pushes at count==MaxPhysicalPages (PushPhysicalPageList:71-87, PopPhysicalPageList:90-105).
Initialized with LRU count=MaxPhysicalPages and other lists count=0 (InitPageRectBounds:134-143).
gaps: Capture size 16388 = 4*(4096+1) proves MaxPhysicalPages=4096 for this capture; the schema value is runtime-sized (GetMaxPhysicalPages).

resourceSchemas.quantity: 6 per-physical-page dirty/invalidate channels, each MaxPhysicalPages uints, plus one trailing uint deferred-invalidation budget counter
resourceSchemas.units: 0/1 flag per channel; trailing counter is a page count
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: physical page linear index; channel index selects the slice

fields.name: InvalidateDynamic
fields.decode: slice 2: !=0 => dynamic page invalidated next render

fields.name: InvalidateStatic
fields.decode: slice 3: !=0 => static page invalidated next render

fields.name: WPOAllowed
fields.decode: slice 4: !=0 => WPO allowed for this page

fields.name: DeferredInvalidationBudgetCounter
fields.decode: index MaxPhysicalPages*6 = atomic count of deferred invalidations consumed this frame

transforms.name: sliceAddress
transforms.expression: sliceIndex = bitIndex of VSM_MARK_PAGE_DIRTY_FLAG_* (1,2,4,8,16,32); address = sliceIndex*MaxPhysicalPages + PhysPageIndex

mathTerms: Allocation: MaxPhysicalPages*VSM_DIRTY_PAGE_FLAGS_NUM_SLICES + 1 (VSMARRAY_C:2787-2788).
Writers set 1 (not OR) per channel; UpdateAndClearDirtyFlags reads and then clears all 6 slices (PhysicalPageManagement.usf:1578-1595).
Slice order is dynamic-dirty, static-dirty, invalidate-dynamic, invalidate-static, WPO-allowed, invalidate-LOD-delta.
gaps: Effective budget semantics come from the DeferredInvalidationBudget uniform/constant, which is not part of this buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: int32 list of selected physical pages; no header word - the list starts at element 0 and the valid count is derived from the paired indirect args; static-array pages are encoded as pageIndex+MaxPhysicalPages
resourceSchemas.units: physical page index (+MaxPhysicalPages for static slice)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: physical page pool linear index; >MaxPhysicalPages selects array slice 1 (static)

formatAlternatives: capacity GetTotalAllocatedPhysicalPages()+1, i.e. 2*MaxPhysicalPages+1 when separate static pages exist

fields.name: PageIndices
fields.decode: array[i], i in [0,Count); page index, or pageIndex+MaxPhysicalPages for static slice; element 0 is the first selected page, NOT a count

transforms.name: staticSliceDecode
transforms.expression: if (Index >= MaxPhysicalPages) { Page=Index-MaxPhysicalPages; ArraySlice=1; } else { Page=Index; ArraySlice=0; }

transforms.name: validCount
transforms.expression: For PhysicalPagesToInitialize: Count = InitializePagesIndirectArgs[0] / TILES_PER_PAGE_1D; for PhysicalPagesToMerge: Count = PostProcessPagesIndirectArgs[0] / TILES_PER_PAGE_1D

mathTerms: EmitPageToProcess adds TILES_PER_PAGE_1D groups per page and writes the page index at slot = (pre-add group count)/TILES_PER_PAGE_1D, so slot 0 is the first page (PhysicalPageManagement.usf:838-844).
TILES_PER_PAGE_1D = 1<<(2*(7-4)) = 64 for a 128-page split into 16x16-pixel tiles of 4x4 threads (LOG2_TILE_SIZE_XY=5) - see :814-832.
gaps: PhysicalPagesToMerge is consumed by MergeStaticPhysicalPagesIndirectCS; PhysicalPagesToInitialize by InitializePhysicalPagesIndirectCS (both in PhysicalPageManagement.usf), not re-anchored here.

resourceSchemas.quantity: uint page-index list used by the prefiltered-distant (filterable shadow) post passes; one list for separable rows/cols and one for 2D filterable merge
resourceSchemas.units: physical page index
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: physical page pool linear index

fields.name: PageIndices
fields.decode: list[slot]=physical page index; separable slot = groups/VSM_PAGE_SIZE; filterable slot = groups/TILES_PER_PAGE_1D

mathTerms: One page needs VSM_PAGE_SIZE (128) groups for the separable filter (one per row/column) and TILES_PER_PAGE_1D groups for the 2D filterable merge.
Only pages with VSM_FLAG_SECONDARY_REQUEST and a projection with bHasPrefilteredDistant are emitted (SelectPagesToPostProcessCS:1037-1058).
gaps: CacheManager.GetMaxFilterablePages() value is runtime (4096 in capture).

resourceSchemas.quantity: 4 indirect-dispatch slots of 4 dwords each (16 uints): [0..3] static-page merge, [4..7] separable filter, [8..11] filterable merge, [12..15] border-processing group count in .x
resourceSchemas.units: dispatch group counts (x,y,z); slot 3 .x is a group count, .yzw unused
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: indirect dispatch argument words consumed by the respective post-process CS dispatches

fields.name: BorderGroups
fields.decode: [12]=number of border groups (1 per separable page); [13..15] unused

transforms.name: inputCounts
transforms.expression: NumPagesToMerge = args[0]/TILES_PER_PAGE_1D; NumSeparablePages = args[4]/VSM_PAGE_SIZE; NumFilterablePages = args[8]/TILES_PER_PAGE_1D; NumBorderPages = args[12]

mathTerms: Created with DimClearValue (0,1,1), 4 slots, stride 4 dwords (VSMARRAY_C:1969).
Slots are offset by PostProcessPagesIndirectArgsBufferStride=4 (VSMARRAY_C:1977).
gaps: The clear pass writes x,y,z=(0,1,1) for each slot; w is not cleared per RHI indirect contract (not proven here).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 1D indirect dispatch: 3 uints
resourceSchemas.units: dispatch group counts
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: 1D dispatch for InitializePhysicalPagesIndirectCS

transforms.name: groupFormula
transforms.expression: args[0] = number of selected pages * TILES_PER_PAGE_1D (TILES_PER_PAGE_1D=64); args[1]=args[2]=1

mathTerms: CreateAndClearIndirectDispatchArgs1D clears to (0,1,1) with stride sizeof(FRHIDispatchIndirectParameters)/4=3 (RendererPrivateUtils.h:541).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 1D indirect dispatch: 3 uints for OutputCommandInstanceListsCs
resourceSchemas.units: dispatch group counts
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: 1D dispatch over the visible-instance list
mathTerms: WriteDispatchIndirectArgs stores (GroupCount,1,1) as three uints at offset 0 (SetupIndirectArgs.usf:14-16).

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 4-dword indirect slot: xyz dispatch args plus w used as the queued-invalidation counter
resourceSchemas.units: group count (x), counter (w)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: 1D dispatch over Shadow.Virtual.GPUInvalidationQueue

fields.name: QueueCount
fields.decode: w = absolute number of queued invalidation items (OutInvalidationArgs[3])

transforms.name: queueDispatch
transforms.expression: x = max over waves of ceil(prev+x/GroupSize); w = total items; ProcessInvalidationQueueGPUCS min(w, InvalidationQueueMax)

mathTerms: Allocated 16 B (1 slot x 4 dwords) by CreateAndClearIndirectDispatchArgs (CacheManager.cpp:2293).
The 4th dword is safe to reuse because indirect compute dispatch consumes only 3 dwords (setup call site), and the queue pass reads it explicitly.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one packed uint32 per queued (instance, view) invalidation; capacity NumInstances*NumViews
resourceSchemas.units: bitfield: instance id (24b), primary-view id (7b), state-change flag (1b)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: indexed by atomic queue slot from GPUInvalidateInstancesArgs.w
mathTerms: Packed with (InstanceId<<8) | (ViewId<<1) | bStateChange; 8-bit flags/24-bit VSM-id split noted in VirtualShadowMapDefinitions.h:69-72 for invalidation payloads, but this queue uses its own 1+7+24 layout.
Producer appends only when a tracked instance transitions to deforming (InvalidationMask = StateChangeMask & IsDeformingMask).

resourceSchemas.quantity: 2 bit-plane words per 32 instances per view: [current deforming-state mask][state-change mask], each of StateWordStride words, laid out per view
resourceSchemas.units: bit per instance
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: GPUScene instance index; view block = 2*SceneRendererViewId*StateWordStride

fields.name: CurrentStateMask
fields.decode: word[BaseStateOffset + WordIndex]; bit (InstanceId&31) set = instance is deforming / cached as dynamic this frame

fields.name: StateChangeMask
fields.decode: word[BaseStateOffset + StateWordStride + WordIndex]; bit set = state changed vs tracked mask

transforms.name: bitIndexing
transforms.expression: BaseStateOffset = 2*SceneRendererViewId*StateWordStride; state word = Base + WordIndex; change word = state word + StateWordStride; WordIndex = InstanceId>>5

mathTerms: Cleared to 0 each frame; transient (not persistent across frames).
StateWordStride = ceil(GPUScene.GetNumInstances()/32) (CacheManager.cpp:2134).
gaps: NumViews in capture is 1 (2 words); the per-view formula is proven by code, not by capture multiplicity.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per persistent view: 2 bit-plane words per 32 instances - cached-as-dynamic mask followed by tracked mask (StateWordStride words each)
resourceSchemas.units: bit per instance
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: GPUScene instance index; per persistent-view buffer

fields.name: CachedAsDynamicMask
fields.decode: word[WordIndex] bit (InstanceId&31): 1 = instance was deforming last update

fields.name: TrackedMask
fields.decode: word[WordIndex+StateWordStride]: 1 = instance has a valid previous-state entry

transforms.name: stateWordIndexing
transforms.expression: WordIndex = InstanceId>>5; state bit = (word[WordIndex]>>(InstanceId&31))&1; tracked bit uses word[WordIndex+StateWordStride]

mathTerms: Constants: FViewData::NumBitsPerInstance=2, stored as two separate 1-bit-per-instance planes (VirtualShadowMapCacheManager.h:550-556).
Captured 4096 B / 1024 words is the initial TPersistentStructuredBuffer capacity, not the instance-count-derived size.
gaps: The capture stale word-count 1024 is a pool/capacity value; treat StateWordStride as the authoritative stride.

resourceSchemas.quantity: per-page hierarchical device-Z (closest occluder) for the physical page pool; base 64x64 per 128x128 page, 7 mip levels
resourceSchemas.units: device Z in [0,1] (clip-space depth, reversed/infinite-far projection)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: HZB physical pool texel space: extent = (max(pow2(PoolSizeX)>>1,1), max(pow2(PoolSizeY)>>1,1)); page (px,py) occupies a 64x64 tile

formatAlternatives: format comes from SetHZBPhysicalPoolSize(..., Format); capture resolved PF_R32_FLOAT
capture ArraySize=1 (no separate static HZB slice); separate static HZB is allowed when StaticHZBArrayIndex>0

fields.name: MinDeviceZ
fields.decode: mip0 texel = min of the 2x2 child device-Z taps (HZBArrayOutput_0[uint3(SrcPos>>1, HZBArrayIndex)]); mip m = min of 2x2 at mip m-1; one channel, different mip levels of the same resource

mathTerms: VSM_PAGE_SIZE=128, so HZB level 0 per page is 64x64 (half physical page size) - explicit comment at PhysicalPageManagement.usf:1755.
VSM::NumHZBLevels = Log2PageSize = 7 (VirtualShadowMapArray.h:86); pool extent is PhysicalPoolSize/2 rounded (SetHZBPhysicalPoolSize).
Despite the 'FurthestHZB' shader variable names, the reduction writes MinDeviceZ (closest occluder); DIM_CLOSEST=0/DIM_FURTHEST=1 are alternative array outputs.
ByteSize 67108864 = 8192*2048*4 covers mip0 only; mip chain memory is not included in the descriptor byte size.
gaps: The mapping from the five RWTexture2DArray<float> outputs (64/32/16/8/4 base levels) onto the single 7-mip array resource is not explicit in the source; element addressing is inferred from BuildHZBPerPage's OutPixelPos>>1 and the pool extent, not from a single pack site.
No captured HZB bytes were inspected; the PF_R32_FLOAT format and extent come from ResourceDescs.json, not from a decode.

resourceSchemas.units: bit flags, shadow-map id, int2 page-coordinate offset
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: VSM data index; PageAddressOffset in virtual page coordinates

fields.name: NextVirtualShadowMapId
fields.decode: replacement id for source data index (KEEP_PAGE)

transforms.name: keepPage
transforms.expression: if ((Flags & KEEP_PAGE) && IsVirtualShadowMapPageAddressValid(Prev.PageAddress+Offset, Prev.MipLevel)) keep page under NextId

resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: VSM mip-view id (packed page info) and GPUScene instance id

resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: scene-renderer primary view index range

resourceSchemas.quantity: one packed shadow mask per screen pixel: 4 bits per light slot for up to PackedShadowMaskMaxLightCount lights (16 in capture -> 2 dwords)

transforms.expression: nibble = round(ShadowFactor*15) & 15 placed at bit (i%8)*4 in dword i/8

resourceSchemas.quantity: one 8-byte link record per culled-link allocation; two mutually exclusive encodings selected by the USE_THREAD_GROUP_PER_CELL permutation
resourceSchemas.units: encoding A: local light index + previous link offset; encoding B: 24-bit primitive index + 16-bit index-in-cell + 24-bit next link offset
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: none (link chain); terminator differs per encoding

fields.name: LinkWord1
fields.decode: encoding A: previous LinkOffset, 0xFFFFFFFF = end; encoding B: ((IndexInCell>>8)&0xFF)<<24 | (LinkOffset & 0xFFFFFF), 0xFFFFFF = end

resourceSchemas.quantity: two uint32 header words per light-grid cell (lights half) and two per reflection-capture cell (second half)

Mega lights are the tail of each cell's run.

mathTerms: Bit layout is exclusive to Lumen; MegaLights reuses the same 8-bit struct with different bit4-7 semantics (FMegaLightsPackedPixelData) - do not cross-apply.
Invalid pixels keep the 0x30 sentinel.
gaps: Capture array size is 1 (legacy substrate); a substrate build has one slice per closure.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint8 bitmask per 8x8-pixel tile per closure slice
resourceSchemas.units: bit flags OR-ed over the tile's pixels
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: tile space: tile = SvPosition/8; array [uint3(TileCoord, ClosureIndex)]

formatAlternatives: extent = ceil(Config.Extent/8) per axis; ArraySize=closure count

transforms.name: tileIndex
transforms.expression: tile = SvPosition >> 3; mask |= per-pixel bit; final = BitFieldExtract(groupMask,10,0)

mathTerms: Tile size 8x8 (StochasticLighting.cpp:31).
Shared-memory reduction reserves 10 bits per subsystem (Lumen/MegaLights/Substrate at 0/10/20); only the low 8 bits survive the R8 store, lossless because Lumen uses <=0x0F.
Capture 17760 bytes = 17760 tiles (e.g. 160x111 or 240x74), 1 slice.
gaps: Exact tile grid depends on the viewport extent, not in ResourceDescs metadata.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one packed world normal + 2 flag bits per screen pixel from the previous frame
resourceSchemas.units: 10:10:10 UNORM normal (world, unit) + 2 flag bits in alpha
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: world-space normal
mathTerms: 2-bit alpha is stored mid-bucket: a=(flags+0.5)/4 so each code decodes robustly.
World-space normal is also used for position bias.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one bit per forward-light index indicating the light is batched for this translucency volume cascade; stored in 32-bit words
resourceSchemas.units: bit mask over forward-light indices
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: forward light index space; one buffer per volume cascade (TVC_MAX=2)

formatAlternatives: NumElements = ceil(MaxBatchedLocalLights/32) words; capture 1 word = 32 light slots

fields.name: LightBit
fields.decode: bit i set => forward light index 32*w+i is batched; consumer iterates firstbitlow and clears

mathTerms: LSB-first bit order (TBitArray).
MaxBatchedLocalLights is padded to a multiple of 32 before upload; padded bits are 0.
gaps: Valid light count (<=32 in capture) is a uniform, not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float4 element of a 3-float4 per-(asset,reversed-mip) record; a full asset slot is 9 float4 = 144 B (3 mips x 3 float4)
resourceSchemas.units: mixed: indirection dimensions in indirection voxels; IndirectionTableOffset in uint32 entries; VolumeToIndirection affine in volume->indirection-voxel units; DistanceFieldToVolumeScaleBias in volume units per UNORM
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: per-mip virtual indirection space derived from normalized mesh volume space (mesh bounds scaled so the max extent maps to [-1,1])

formatAlternatives: forced 16-byte structured stride; logical per-(asset,mip) record is 48 B and per-asset slot 144 B

fields.name: Vector0.x
fields.decode: low10 IndirectionDimensions.x, next10 .y, next10 .z, top2 NumMips

mathTerms: DistanceField::NumMips=3, AssetDataMipStrideFloat4s=3, DF_ASSET_DATA_STRIDE=9.
Indirection dimensions are 10 bits each, cap 1024; NumMips is 2 bits (top of word0).
Hand packed: C++ writes IntVector0[0..3] and the HLSL loader reads word0/1/2; there is no mirrored C++ struct or static_assert.
gaps: No GPU live count: dead asset slots have NumMips==0; the capture 144 B is one asset slot of capacity, not a count of live mips.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float4 element of a 48-byte per-object bounds record (3 float4): world center high/low, sphere radius, AABB extent, 6 flags
resourceSchemas.units: world-space centimetres (UE units); flags unitless
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: absolute world space stored as double-float High/Low; consumers subtract ViewOrigin to get translated world

fields.name: Flags
fields.decode: bits0 OftenMoving,1 CastShadow,2 IsNaniteMesh,3 EmissiveLightSource,4 Visible,5 AffectIndirectLightingWhileHidden

transforms.name: center
transforms.expression: CenterWorld = PositionHigh + PositionLow; TranslatedCenter = DFFastToTranslatedWorld(Center, PreViewTranslation)

mathTerms: 3 float4 per object; bounds are primitive world bounds (center from PrimAndInst.Origin + WorldBoundsRelativeToOrigin, extent = GetExtent()).
Flags are packed from C++ booleans; only 6 bits used.
gaps: Word0.w is written but unused; live object count is NumObjectsInBuffer (uniform), not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one float4 element of a 160-byte per-object record (10 float4): position high, world<->volume affine matrices, volume extent/bias, draw distances, GPU instance index, volume scale, asset index
resourceSchemas.units: volume space is dimensionless (max mesh extent maps to [-1,1]); VolumeToWorldScale is cm per volume unit; SelfShadowBias is world cm (converted by 1/max(VolumeToWorldScale) at DistanceFieldShadowingShared.ush:121); MinMaxDrawDistance2 is cm^2
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: volume space = mesh local space scaled by 1/max(extent); matrices relative to translated world

fields.name: PositionHigh
fields.decode: PreTranslation of the FDF inverse matrix

mathTerms: 10 float4 = 160 B per object; VolumeScale is derived as min(VolumeToWorldScale.xyz) and is not stored.
HLSL FDFObjectData declaration order is NOT the buffer layout; readers use explicit word indices.
SelfShadowBias is converted to volume units by 1/max(VolumeToWorldScale) in the shadowing shader.
gaps: bMostlyTwoSided is encoded only as the sign of word4.w; if ExpandSurfaceDistance==0 the bit would be lost (not guarded).
Live object count is NumObjectsInBuffer (uniform), not stored.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint32 per asset slot: desired number of loaded mips (1..3; 0 = no request)
resourceSchemas.units: mip count (integer)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: asset-slot index space (sparse-set asset id), not spatial

fields.name: WantedNumMips
fields.decode: cleared to 1; InterlockedMax with 2/3 when the object AABB intersects mip1/mip2 extents

mathTerms: Producer: ComputeDistanceFieldAssetWantedMipsCS; consumer: GenerateDistanceFieldAssetStreamingRequestsCS requests when WantedNumMips!=0 && NumMips!=0 && NumMips!=Wanted.
DistanceField::NumMips=3.
gaps: Live asset count is the NumDistanceFieldAssets shader uniform, not stored in the buffer.

resourceSchemas.quantity: element 0 = record count N, then N records of 2 uint32 {AssetIndex, WantedNumMips}; capacity MaxStreamingRequests*2+1
resourceSchemas.units: asset id and mip count; header is a record count
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: none (index/count space)

transforms.name: recordAddress
transforms.expression: AssetIndex = buf[1+2*i]; WantedNumMips = buf[2+2*i]; i < min(buf[0],4095)

mathTerms: In 5.8.1 this buffer has exactly ONE record shape (asset mip requests); there is no type tag and no DF-object request branch. DF object add/remove is CPU-driven.
The producer increments the header before the capacity check, so the header can overcount dropped records; the record write is guarded by index<4095.
gaps: The task-level premise of two request kinds (asset mip + DF object) is false for this engine version; no such branch exists in source.

resourceSchemas.quantity: one uint4 per (GDF page, 3D cell): four candidate object slots, each a packed 24-bit GPUSceneInstanceIndex + 8-bit normalized distance
resourceSchemas.units: per slot: 24-bit instance index and 8-bit normalized distance code; cell world size derives from ClipmapVoxelExtent (cm)
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: GDF page-grid cell space: cell offset = ZOrder3DEncode(coord,2) in 0..63; buffer index = 64*Page.PageIndex + cellOffset
mathTerms: MaxQueryDistance = 1.44*CellWorldExtent + 3*ClipmapVoxelExtent; CellWorldExtent = ClipmapVoxelExtent*7/4.
Entries are insertion-sorted ascending so smaller packed distance (nearest) comes first; AddToObjectGridCell replaces the current max only when the new value is smaller.
Consumer iterates 4 slots and breaks at the first 0xFFFFFFFF.
gaps: Producer has no bounds check on Page.PageIndex (relies on the page allocator); MaxPageNum is runtime (capture implies 114688 = 128*128*7 pages).
The 8-bit distance is decoded by the pack formula but the Lumen consumer ignores it (uses only the instance index); inverse decode is lossy.

resourceSchemas.quantity: 64 uint32 stats slots; only slots 0..2 are written (valid-page count, empty-page count, updated-page count)
resourceSchemas.units: GDF page counts per frame
resourceSchemas.coordinateSpace: none (counter slots)

fields.name: Combi
fields.decode: InterlockedAdd per valid page across clipmaps

fields.name: Empty
fields.decode: per valid page with no interior sample strictly between 0 and 1

mathTerms: GLOBAL_DISTANCE_FIELD_PAGE_GROUP_NUM = (8/4)^3 = 8.
Purely debug counters (bound only by GlobalDistanceFieldDebugCS); cleared each frame.
gaps: Counters have different accumulation scopes (0/1 jointly across clipmaps, 2 summed per cache layer and clipmap so a page updated in both layers counts twice); they are not guaranteed mutually consistent.
Why capacity is 64 is undocumented; 61 slots are dead.

coverageGaps.missingSourceFact: The required family might be expected to carry both asset-mip and DF-object streaming requests, but 5.8.1 source contains only GenerateDistanceFieldAssetStreamingRequestsCS with one {AssetIndex,WantedNumMips} record shape and no type tag; object add/remove is CPU-driven (FDistanceFieldSceneData::AsyncUpdate/UpdateDistanceFieldObjectBuffers).
